description.text: Horde
consists of mobs that will spawn commonly in large quantities, they have lower stats overall.
Assassin
mobs are high damaging less common mobs that are a threat to be taken seriously. They will have higher damage stats than Horde mobs.
Tanks
are high HP sponges that will test your single target strength, they will however spawn in much smaller quantities so you can focus them.
Dungeon
mobs are much stronger than their regular variants and scale with the dungeons difficulty.
Vault Dwellers
are the denizens of the vault and will provide environmental threats to the player in difficulties greater than Hard.
Bosses
guard the vault's greatest prizes. Each one fights in its own arena with its own attacks and phases.
Ash Moths
burst out of the Great Pyre once it is activated. Every one you kill feeds the flame.
Rains poison spores on anyone beneath it. Burst it down fast to topple it and it takes extra damage while down.
Leaps onto your back and drains your health. Sneak twice to shake it off, or have a teammate knock it loose.
A slow, smouldering corpse that climbs out of the ash. Comes in numbers, also around the Great Pyre.
A small frost imp that lunges with its ice spear. Its hits slow you for a moment.
A walking mushroom that swats you with a puff of spores.
A thorny sprout that hops at you and rakes with its claws.
A little crystal crawler that jabs with its shard arms.
A cursed rag doll that shuffles after you and scratches with hexed hands.
A hovering clockwork bug that dives in to drill you.
A haunted lantern that floats toward you and scorches you with its ghost flame.
A one-eyed ink blot on four legs that bites in packs.
A gold-greedy piglin brute that marches in packs and hacks with its cleaver.
A barnacle-crusted sailor that comes in packs and clubs you with its oar.
A soul-fire hound. From 3 to 6 blocks away it leaps at you and bites on landing.
A sand scorpion that springs at you from 3 to 6 blocks away. Its pinch poisons.
Chases you down and pounces from 3 to 6 blocks. Lose it for a few seconds and it goes still like a rock; walk within 4 blocks or hit it and it ambushes you.
A biting plant that lunges at you from 3 to 6 blocks. Lose it and it roots in place, then snaps at anyone who comes within 4 blocks or strikes it.
A basalt brute with a shield. When struck up close it raises its guard for 2 seconds and takes 60% less damage.
A sandstone guardian. When struck up close it braces for 2 seconds and takes 60% less damage.
A hulking miner carrying a glowing ore vein. When struck up close it covers up for 2 seconds and takes 60% less damage.
A frosted ram. From 5 to 14 blocks with a clear run it charges head down; the hit deals 50% more damage and knocks you far. It stuns itself on walls.
Fires its cannon shell from range. Break the shell at half health and it loses the cannon, but runs much faster.
Stands frozen like an ice sculpture until you get close. Its lunge cuts twice and chills you.
A small moth of living ash that pours out of the Great Pyre. It bites, then darts back out of reach. Each kill adds heat to the Pyre.
A huge ash moth that joins the Pyre's waves once enough fuel is burned. Its wing buffet knocks players back and blinds them. Worth four heat.
Velara's champion, a bark knight guarding her grove. The bloom on his chest opens only for a moment, so strike it then. Jump his thorn rings and sidestep his thorn lines.
Wendarr's champion, a clockwork knight with a pendulum poleaxe. A golden echo repeats his big swings a moment later. Carry storm cores into his lightning shield to break it.
Tenos' champion, a floating oracle who reads where you are going and casts there. Break the catalysts of his ward to make his tome fall.
The Halloween champion of the Hollow Court. He snuffs the court's lanterns and hits harder in the dark. Falling once is not the end of him.
Made by the four gods to carry all of their powers. The Greed vault's final guardian.
